title: Sound Design vs Music Composition: Which Does Your Project Need?
h1: Sound design vs music composition: which does your project need?
description: The difference between sound design and composing music for videos, games, apps and ads, what each specialist delivers and how to brief them.
intro: Audio is half of the experience in videos, games, apps and ads, yet buyers often ask for music when what they need is sound effects, or the other way round. Sound designers create the effects and atmospheres that make actions feel real. Composers write music that sets mood and emotion. Many projects need both, working together. This article explains the difference, what each delivers and how to brief them.

faq.a: For many simple videos, licensed stock music works. Custom music helps when you need a unique identity.
A background sound that sets the scene, such as city noise, wind or a busy office.
